nom: Murad Rapid Relief Acne Sulfur Clay Mask

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone/oily skin report reduced oiliness and smoother, less congested skin, with several calling it a holy grail for oily/combination skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the mask does not overly dry or strip the face, though one dry-skin reviewer limits use to the T-zone and another finds it a bit drying and follows with a moisturizing mask.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe it as balancing, reducing oiliness in oily zones while not over-drying drier areas, with breakouts diminishing.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers report the mask is gentle and non-irritating even with regular use, but one reviewer with sensitive skin says it burned and left her face numb, and another warns sensitive skin might tingle.
segments.mature: One reviewer mentions using the mask alongside exfoliants and retinol as part of an anti-aging routine, but mature skin is not otherwise discussed.

concerns.aging: Only incidentally mentioned; one reviewer pairs the mask with retinol/exfoliants but no direct anti-aging effect is described.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describe the mask as non-stripping and not overly drying, with moisturizer recommended afterward; a couple with dry/dehydrated skin note some tightness or dryness on drier areas and use it selectively or follow with extra moisturizer.
concerns.redness: The large majority report reduced redness and calmer skin, often within a day, including for hormonal acne, rosacea and perioral dermatitis; no dissent reported on this point.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers consistently say it does not compromise or irritate the skin barrier, with several noting it avoids the tightness or cracked feeling of typical clay masks; one sensitive-skin user reports burning and numbness instead.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report dark spots and acne scars fading with continued use, alongside general clearing of blemishes.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including many with hormonal, cystic, and fungal acne, report visibly smaller, drier, and faster-healing blemishes, some after a single use; one reviewer reports no real change in her acne and feels it just masks the problem temporarily.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily and combination skin consistently report reduced oiliness and a more balanced, matte finish without dryness.

aspects.libelle: Fast, visible results after one use

extraits.titre: I would not buy this product again
extraits.texte: This product did help with acne that's a plus!! but,I have sensitive skin and it burned my face and it felt like I put something really cold on it and it felt like my face was numb. So for people with sensitive skin I would not recommend this

complimentary from Murad. At first, the mask worked perfectly, it removed the surface layer of dirt from my clogged pores. But, after finishing the rest of my skincare, they looked the as before. This mask doesn't get rid of them but masks the problem to showcase immediate results. As for acne, I didn't see any change.

extraits.titre: LIFE CHANGING FOR FUNGAL AND HORMONAL ACNE.
extraits.texte: I have struggled with hormonal acne for years, and recently it began to get much worse. I had tiny red bumps and whiteheads everywhere, especially around the chin and forehead, and I noticed it would get better after a professional Oxygen facial or hydrafacial, but would quickly returned. It seemed to get worse any time I oil cleansed or wore makeup. I started to think that maybe this is fungal, and did some research. I found that Sulfur is a good ingredient for combatting both fungal and regular acne so I wanted to try that before trying a prescription anti fungal. I found this mask and read the reviews and bought the mask. After ONE USE, the breakout was almost 100% gone. All the red textured bumps are gone and any pustular spots are dried up and healing. My face looks like a completely different person. I have never been so happy with a product in my life. The 5% sulfur is pure gold. I AM SO HAPPY THANK YOU TO THIS PRODUCT.

extraits.titre: Has helped clear my skin (hormonal acne/rosacea)
extraits.texte: 32 years old and about 2 years ago my skin started breaking out so bad. My dermatologist diagnosed me with rosacea. Prescription meds/cream and Cera Ve products helped with overall redness, but I'd still get acne during my period especially on my chin. I also live in a desert and work in dentistry, so sweat/masks/makeup would cause breakouts too. This stuff clears up the hormonal/cystic acne so well and calms the redness from it. I can use it more than it reccomends as long as I moisturize after. Thanks to this I finally have my skin under control! Thank you 🙏

Gifted by Murad | dehydrated and sensitive skin, but occasionally get breakouts from stress, PMS, or lack of sleep. I used this just once during a pretty bad week of breakouts. It does feel tight as most clay masks do, especially on the drier/dehydrated parts of my face. I noticed an immediate difference in my breakout the next day. Redness and inflammation were reduced! I think I'll use this more as a spot treatment vs. an all-over mask.

Murad gifted me their Rapid Relief Acne Sulfur Clay Mask with Salicylic Acid. I love using salicylic acid for acne control. I usually use it as a cleanser. I have been using this mask for extra control and skin clearing ability. Since I have dry skin, I have only been using this on my T-zone, where I need it most. I don't think it is too drying. I apply moisturizer right after cleaning it off. It seems to be working.

Fantastic mask! Even though I don't suffer from acne, only the occasional breakout, this mask is excellent at quickly treating them and accelerating the healing. It also does a wonderful job of cleaning my pores! It can be a bit drying, so I typically follow it up with a moisturizing mask.
